messages:
maria_cs: Quick async check-in: two things for today - NovaPay renewal is at risk due to webhook delivery failures (support ticket opened overnight), and I need a quick code review on a tiny retry-policy change.

maria_cs: Yesterday: reproduced failure in staging and collected the failed callback logs. Blocker: not sure if our retries are amplifying the problem because customer origin returns 502 and our system keeps retrying. Today: coordinate with eng on a hotfix and prep a concise summary for the renewal call.

kevin_oncall: I can take the initial investigation. Drop the failing request IDs and I9ll run a live trace against staging.

maria_cs: Thanks @kevin_oncall. IDs: 9a4b1c, 9a4b2d, 9a4b9f. Pattern: immediate 502 from customer endpoint, then our retry loop queues more callbacks.

anita_eng: Noted. We shipped a change last week to cap retries, but metrics show lots of queued events still. I9ll look at batching behavior and whether a routing fallback reissued requests.

kevin_oncall: Running curl reproducer now:
```
curl -v -X POST https://staging-callbacks.redwood.example/hooks -d '{"id":"9a4b1c"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
Getting 502 from their origin on the same payload.

ops-bot: Incident created - INC-2026-1347: nova-pay webhooks failing. Tickets: #CS-9123. Assigned kevin_oncall and notified eng.

lee_adops: Heads up: NovaPay said they deployed a new per-IP rate limit yesterday. If true, our retry bursts could look like a flood from their perspective. Can we ask them to confirm and consider a temporary whitelist?

maria_cs: I9m on a call with their account lead at 10:30 PT. I9ll confirm the rollout and request a temporary whitelist while we put mitigations in place.

anita_eng: Quick finding: one Dedicated node evicted a model shard around 03:20 UTC, which caused routing fallback for a subset of traffic. That could be multiplying callback attempts if fallback triggers re-dispatch.

kevin_oncall: If fallback reissues requests, we9re potentially multiplying retries. Proposal for immediate mitigation: enable a soft limit for NovaPay that sets retries to 3 with jitter and disables aggressive immediate requeue. I can push a feature-flagged hotfix to staging.

maria_cs: Please do. Also need a quick CR review for the hotfix  PR #4821 — tiny delta in retry logic.

anita_eng: Reviewing PR #4821 now. One nit: reduce log level for non-actionable retry warnings. After that I can sign off and we can promote. Also adding a NovaPay-specific dashboard panel for retry count.

kevin_oncall: Pushed change to honor per-customer feature flag and lowered logging. Rolling to staging now. Will run the staging checklist and report back in ~15m.

maria_cs: Can you include the staging verification steps so CS can validate with NovaPay if they whitelist our IPs?

kevin_oncall: Staging checklist: 1) run curl test same payload and confirm 502 from origin is not followed by >3 retries; 2) check /metrics: webhook_retries_total{customer="novapay"} <= 3; 3) queue_length for novapay callbacks drops below threshold within 5m.

anita_eng: 12m update: staging shows retry cap in effect, queue lag decreased, and alerts cleared. I9ll roll the hotfix to a small canary segment in prod next.

josh_sales: Heads up for the renewal call at 16:00 CET  if this persists we should have a one-slide timeline of actions and next steps.

maria_cs: Will prepare the slide after the post-mortem with ops. @lee_adops please confirm whitelist outcome during your vendor followup. @josh_sales I9ll ping you with the summary before the call.

kevin_oncall: Canary in prod looks stable over 20m. No retry storms observed. I9ll close the incident once support ticket gets customer ack.

maria_cs: Customer acknowledged workaround and appreciated the quick response. I9ll update the renewal thread and mark this as resolved once CS ticket is updated. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
